from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe')
commands=[
 ['git','status','--short'],
 [str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','pytest','-q','tests/test_ats_adapter_contract.py','-k','jobvite and explicit_confirmation_produces_verified_evidence','--maxfail=1'],
 [str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','pytest','-q','tests/test_jobctl.py','--maxfail=1']
]
for cmd in commands:
 p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=repo,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=110)
 print('COMMAND',cmd,'EXIT',p.returncode)
 print('STDOUT',p.stdout[-4500:])
 print('STDERR',p.stderr[-1000:])
 if p.returncode: raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
